historical_run.model: gpt-image-2-5-sunburst for the concept and Meshy 7.1 for 3D, according to the historical README.
historical_run.note: Credits and model attribution are historical README observations, not newly verified API responses. The exact generation timestamp and task response were not retained in this record. Archived tutorial observations (not a new run or inspection): Historical README reported concept generation in 37–40 s; 2K geometry in 3 min 33 s–3 min 36 s versus 4K in 6 min 09 s–6 min 30 s on two chest concepts. Observed triangle counts were about 0.96 million at 2K and 0.93–1.12 million at 4K. An 8K texture run took 12 min 15 s and produced a 108 MB file. These comparisons are observations, not a controlled quality benchmark.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; GLB JSON accessors and mesh/material/image/skin/animation arrays.
artifact_inspection.note: Inspected existing python/output artifacts without calling Meshy. These ignored runtime files are not required for validation or export. Curated previews in assets/ show these samples; the model files are not published by this repository.
